title: DISPOSAL OF PERSONS ARRESTED During the year 1967, a total of 6,82,871 persons were charge-sheeted as compared to 6,88,009 persons during 1966. Out of this total, 2,93,945 persons were convicted. Table II(c) presents percentage of conviction to total cases in which charge-sheets were filed during the year 1963 to 1967.
